provenance.teams: Club websites and social handles were read off each club's official nfl.com/teams/<slug>/ page (the league-published social directory), fetched and reviewed 2026-09-10. Washington's nfl.com page listed no Snapchat. The pipeline re-parses these pages live every 7 days and overwrites this cache; failed parses degrade to probe-pending and raise a DIRECTORY_TEAM_* flag instead of guessing.
provenance.social: Bluesky statuses transcribed verbatim from live keyless public AppView responses (app.bsky.actor.getProfile / app.bsky.actor.searchActors) fetched and reviewed 2026-09-10. The pipeline re-runs these probes every 24h and overwrites this cache. X cannot be verified without a paid/keyless-restored endpoint; oEmbed returned HTTP 403 on 2026-09-10, so every X row is a one-click manual-review link. CI validation 2026-09-10: the runner's health ledger probed app.bsky.actor.searchActors (200), app.bsky.actor.getProfile for rapsheet.bsky.social (200, verification valid) and publish.twitter.com oembed (200 from the runner IP); the remaining seed names are resolved by live search on the next collect run.

methodology.official: Club websites and social handles are parsed from each club's own nfl.com team page (the league-published social directory) and carry the fetch status/timestamp as evidence.
methodology.national_bluesky: Keyless public AppView: 'verified' requires an exact display name match AND verification.verifiedStatus=='valid'; exact matches without a checkmark are manual-review 'candidates'; accounts with impersonation/parody labels or mirror/bot handles are recorded as non-official warnings.
methodology.national_x: X has no free verification API in 2026 (oEmbed returned HTTP 403 on 2026-09-10). X entries are one-click manual-verification links until an automated probe succeeds; they are never claimed machine-verified.
methodology.beat: Names/outlets/clubs come verbatim from beat-writer attributions inside the live ESPN injury feed. No social handles are asserted for beat writers; only exact-name search deep links are provided for manual review.
methodology.evidence: Every row links to the page that produced it. The raw probe log is in data/latest/meta.json and the probe ledger on the Sources tab.
